reference_prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain warm-grey background for an original character, 'the Corporal': a man in his late twenties with a tired, decent face, short cropped dark hair and light stubble. Three full-body views side by side (front, three-quarter, profile) wearing a plain olive army field jacket over a white T-shirt, plus a fourth view of the same man in civilian clothes: a pale blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers. Two small head studies (worried, resolved). Consistent proportions, clean even lighting, no text labels.

extra_visuals.prompt: Somber, dramatic, non-graphic. Dramatic low-angle composition: an old, generic badge with no insignia or lettering lies cracked on a wet seawall railing in the foreground, sharp focus; behind it, out of focus, a neon-lit 1980s coastal skyline at dusk in magenta and teal, palm silhouettes. Strong rim light on the badge's crack. Large empty area of sky on the left for title text.
